title: Excellent service
text: Excellent visit, we met quickly the Alhambra. The trip seems perfect when you have little time and do not stay in Granada. However the little is little for the size of such beautiful monument. My recommendation is to repeat the visit and spend more time there and a better walk by pomegranate. Thank you to Karlos for your guidance and excellent care
author: albertog786

title: Excellent organization
text: Beautiful building. Very well organized trip. Very good and helpful the two guides: Antonio and Marina. Antonio, from Seville, effectively managed the trip and the stops, also providing us with a lot of useful information and meeting some needs. Marina, from Granada. guided us courteously and competently through the various palaces and gardens visited.

title: A wonderful day in Granada and the Alhambra
text:
It was a wonderful experience. It was a private tour for 4 of us girlfriends. Lucca our driver was an excellent guide too on the trip- sharing the land’s history and very passionate about it. He answered our questions thoroughly
but we also managed to share laughs along the way. He recommended a  very good restaurant for lunch always giving us several options. We then were guided in the Alhambra tour by Nina the local guide. title: From Seville to Granada on a pleasant journey
text: Very good experience! Very attentive the guide and people of the company office in Seville to solve problems. Because of some problem of the platform through which I bought the tour (which was not from Naturanda but another portal), I got the tickets only for the trip without the tickets to La Alhambra. Then I arranged to buy the entrance tickets to La Alhambra from another supplier. When I told the people of Naturanda about the problem (that on the round trip I was going to do it with them but the tour of the palaces of La Alhambra was going to do it with another supplier) they were very will
